name: Riverland Internet
summary: Regional SA ISP (Riverland/Murray Mallee; riverland.net.au online by Jan 1997); fate unverified (THE MURRAY PIONEER PROPRIETARY LIMITED, ACN 007 871 007).

refs.label: Earliest capture 21 Jan 1997 carries an explicit Dec 1995 start claim; business name 'Riverland Internet'.
ABR confirms Riverland Internet is an other-name of The Murray Pioneer Pty Ltd (SA).

events.details: Ceased operating — closed between Aug 2012 and Apr 2013.

refs.label: Still trading as an ISP (net.au style dial-up/ADSL/email) on 22 Aug 2012.
Closure notice in place by 9 Apr 2013; web/email handed to local 'Riverland Web & Email Services'.
ABR: THE MURRAY PIONEER PROPRIETARY LIMITED ACN 007 871 007
